title: Good Vibes Only Home - 1.7 miles from downtown
description:
Welcome to the Good Vibes Only home! A beautiful, charming and cozy home centrally located - only 2 miles or less to several popular areas like downtown Nashville, the Gulch, Germantown, Midtown and the Nations. This is a spacious, open concept 3 bedroom/2.5 bath that can accommodate up to 10 people comfortably! Thoughtful touches throughout the house to ensure you'll find all the comforts of home.

The space
Home layout: 
- Ground level master bed/full bath and 1/2 bath 
- Second floor contains beautiful reading nook, two large guest bedrooms and one full bath 
- Fenced yard and gate to provide extra privacy 
- Lovely outdoor space with pergola for your enjoyment!
- Plenty of parking spaces (driveway and street parking)

**Home is thoroughly cleaned and disinfected after each stay according to the protocols set forth by the CDC**

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire house!

Other things to note
There’s a detached 2- car garage on the property that is not available for guests. Sorry for the inconvenience.
